assumptions.choice: Aggregate the supplied 1-minute bars into session-aligned 15-minute periods; the first four periods from 09:30 through 10:29 define the opening range, and later breakouts use completed 15-minute closes.
assumptions.reason: The feed is 1-minute while the specification requires primary opening-range and breakout analysis on 15-minute data.

assumptions.choice: Use the direction of a 50-period SMA of completed, session-aligned 1-hour closes; upward direction permits longs and downward direction permits shorts.
assumptions.reason: The specification names SMA 50 on a higher timeframe and gives 1-hour as the applicable example.

assumptions.choice: Treat an impulse as strong once its move from the broken opening-range boundary is at least one complete opening-range width.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires a strong impulse but provides no numerical threshold.

assumptions.choice: Measure retracements from the broken range boundary to the post-breakout impulse extreme; enter when a 1-minute bar reaches the inclusive 50%-61.8% zone and its close reverses versus the prior 1-minute close.
assumptions.reason: The specification specifies the Fibonacci zone and reversal direction but not swing anchoring or an exact reversal pattern.

assumptions.choice: Use plain self.buy() and self.sell() without an explicit size.
assumptions.reason: Position sizing is unspecified, so the canonical default applies.

assumptions.choice: Place a target two times the actual entry-to-stop risk from the completed entry price.
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly supplies 1:2 risk-to-reward as the reasonable default.
